d: Before a young, energetic Golden Retriever can be a companion for a family, Brandon will have to teach him control and how to safely navigate around wheelchairs.

Brandon must earn the trust of a Wheaten Terrier Mix who shows difficulty adjusting to life outside of a cage. But only time will tell if this anxious animal can be fully prepared for life in the busy tourist town of Solvang, California.
To prepare a young Foxhound for a woman hoping for a companion, Brandon will have to help the dog overcome her separation anxiety and keep her nose out of trouble.
Eric and Rashi place three different shelter dogs into the homes of adopters whose lives revolve around music, photography and an assortment of arts and crafts.
Eric checks in with past adopters whose isolation during the initial COVID-19 lockdown inspired the decision to welcome a new furry friend into their lives.
Brandon rescues a malnourished Poodle mix, suffering from an upper respiratory infection, in hopes that she might be the perfect companion for a woman coming to grips with her own failing eyesight.
Before a rescued Malamute mix can provide comfort to a teenager with anxiety, Brandon must first help the dog overcome his own emotional issues.
Brandon rescues five dogs who all face lengthy recoveries from various afflictions. But with patience and love, they are soon trained and united with their new forever families.

A three-month-old puppy that was left at the shelter could be the perfect match for a couple with two young daughters. But, before Brandon will sign off on the adoption, Buster must learn a few rules of basic obedience and house training.
Brandon reunites with two previous adopters and learns how his former students went on to become life-changers for military veterans.
Three shelter dogs are placed with active adopters whose lifestyles offer them adventures like kayaking, bike riding and in-line skating.

Brandon turns to hand signals to train a deaf dog for a busy hotel executive. But before he'll “sign-off” on the adoption, he must be completely confident that Milo's manners and temperament will result in more than just an overnight stay.
When Brandon and his Lucky Dog team join a local parade to raise awareness for animal rescue, some of his former students show up to support the cause.
A young miniature pinscher mix must learn to harness its energy before it can be placed with a fashion photographer who wants a dog that can join him in public.
Good things come to three different adopters who open their homes to pint-sized shelter dogs.
Brandon rescues a gentle, yet consistently overlooked Staffordshire Bull Terrier in hopes of placing her in a home with another dog that is struggling with timidity.
